title: Justin Shorter 2023 Panini Prizm - (RC) - #310 Buffalo Bills Rookie NFL
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2023 Panini Prizm trading card features Justin Shorter, a rookie player for the Buffalo Bills in the National Football League (NFL). The card is a standard size and has a Prizm parallel/variety. It has not been autographed and is part of the 2023 Panini Prizm set.

The front of the card showcases Justin Shorter in his Buffalo Bills uniform, with his name and team displayed prominently. The back of the card includes his player information and statistics. This card is a must-have for any collector or fan of Justin Shorter or the Buffalo Bills.
